'''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a [[Quests|Quest]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Dialogue==
{{quote|Greetings, mercenary. My contacts are in need of a large supply of military equipment. You could definitely help us in this matter. Will you find the required items for us? I will make a list of the needed equipment.}}

==Requirements==
* Must reach Loyalty Level 4 with [[Peacekeeper]] to obtain this quest.

==Objectives==
* Find 5 [[VPX Flash Storage Module]]s [[Found in raid|<font color="red">in raid</font>]]
* Find 5 [[UHF RFID Reader]]s [[Found in raid|<font color="red">in raid</font>]]
* Find 5 [[Virtex programmable processor]]s [[Found in raid|<font color="red">in raid</font>]]
* Find 5 [[Military COFDM Wireless Signal Transmitter]]s [[Found in raid|<font color="red">in raid</font>]]
* Find 4 [[Military flash drive]]s [[Found in raid|<font color="red">in raid</font>]]
* Hand over 5 [[VPX Flash Storage Module]]s to [[Peacekeeper]]
* Hand over 5 [[UHF RFID Reader]]s to [[Peacekeeper]]
* Hand over 5 [[Virtex programmable processor]]s to [[Peacekeeper]]
* Hand over 5 [[Military COFDM Wireless Signal Transmitter]]s to [[Peacekeeper]]
* Hand over 4 [[Military flash drive]]s to [[Peacekeeper]]

==Rewards==
* +65,000 [[EXP]]
* +4 [[Pistols|Pistols skill]] levels
* +4 [[Revolvers|Revolvers skill]] levels
* [[Peacekeeper]] Rep <font color="green">'''+1.5'''</font>
* 2,750 [[Dollars]]
** 2,888 Dollars with [[Hideout#Modules|Intelligence Center]] Level 1
** 3,163 Dollars with [[Hideout#Modules|Intelligence Center]] Level 2
* Unlocks barter for [[T H I C C item case]] at [[Peacekeeper]] LL4
* Unlocks craft for [[5.56x45mm M855A1]] at [[Hideout#modules|Workbench level 3]]
{{quote|Good, good. We highly appreciate all you have done for us, mercenary. See you later.}}
